The '''Kazlin system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kazlin 5]], where the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Tyu]] operated.<ref name="CRO">{{JournalCite|10|Cracken's Rebel Operatives (article)}}</ref>
